case: citext[] result, typed binding, grid edit, and CSV round trip
contract: Binary result decoding preserves exact citext[] labels, multidimensional shape, zero-based lower bounds, empty elements, literal NULL text, escaped quotes, Unicode, SQL NULL, and empty arrays.
Inferred bound reads and writes preserve the native citext[] type and array_send bytes; citext case-insensitive comparison semantics remain PostgreSQL-owned.
Keyed grid editing and CSV export/import preserve native type, text, JSON values, and array_send bytes while leaving the sibling row unchanged.
Malformed array text is refused before changing the target row; a same-named composite type remains visibly undecodable.
The existing 64-level enum-array parameter inference refusal boundary remains intact.

remaining: Other custom PostgreSQL array families remain open in B3.

PgTypeInfo exposes custom type name and kind but not namespace; a non-extension simple base type named citext is not distinguished by this decoder. The code marks the boundary and OID-based extension membership is the upgrade path if that collision is in scope.
